name: intention-bot
description: Help Muslims form sincere intentions for permissible everyday actions, connect them to relevant Quran guidance, and turn them into a concise dua.

interface.longDescription: Simply type what you are doing — even just a few words like 'washing dishes' or 'helping my mom with groceries.' Intention Bot turns the activity into a concise list of sincere Islamic intentions, brief relevant Quran guidance with direct Quran.com links, and a personalized dua. No special prompt is needed. Intention Bot is designed for everyday spiritual reflection and education. It does not claim to be a scholar or provide binding religious rulings, and it does not imply that a good intention can make an impermissible act permissible.

publication.release_notes: Make Intention Bot easier to use: users can now simply type the activity they are doing, with starter examples such as washing dishes, helping with groceries, or going to work.
